short_description: Streamline Telco — a broadband + mobile carrier's churn-save-on-the-call rescue. A network outage colliding with billing friction and a competitor promo pushed a cluster of subscribers into elevated churn risk, faster than the nightly report could surface. A care-agent app reads governed subscriber data at low latency, a retention recommendation ranks the offer (plan-upgrade discount / bill credit / device upgrade) per at-risk subscriber, and a care lead approves — turning governed lakehouse data into an on-call action at full contact-center concurrency, with the assistant's AI spend capped and predictable per call.
